answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 29943 Country: Bangladesh Title: I have sold my car @ taka 1350000 but he fails to pay in schedule time. can i sell to some one else now? Question: I have sold my car @ taka 1350000 but he fails to pay in schedule time. can i sell to some one else now? Answer ID: 29943 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 325/325/M=1432) If the buyer seeks some more time and it is not harmful for you, you should give him some time and wait; it shall be counted as your good manner. If you feel that the buyer is delaying without any reason, you have the right to cancel the dealing and sell it to someone else. But if you have taken some price, return it.b Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
